title: Parts of speech with SpaCy library

cues.en: Parts of speech are categories of words like nouns, verbs, adjectives, and so on.
cues.zh: 詞性，就是名詞、動詞、形容詞等字詞類別。

cues.en: Parts of speech are obviously a major part of understanding the structure and use of language, and
cues.zh: 詞性顯然是理解語言結構與使用方式的重要部分，

cues.en: therefore parts of speech, is also a major part of trying to understand how computers process natural
cues.zh: 因此，也是理解電腦如何處理自然

cues.en: language and mechanistic interpretability of language models.
cues.zh: 語言，以及語言模型機制可解釋性的重要部分。

cues.en: Now, you have already seen a few ways in this course of incorporating parts of speech into model investigations,
cues.zh: 這門課已經看過幾種，將詞性納入模型研究的方法，

cues.en: but a lot of the methods that I showed so far were either looking at single words with no context,
cues.zh: 但目前示範的許多方式，要不是查看沒有上下文的單一字詞，

cues.en: or fairly small data sets that were specifically crafted for the particular analysis.
cues.zh: 就是為特定分析，刻意設計相當小的資料集。

cues.en: Now, the problem with that approach, like the sentences with him and her and round, is that they.
cues.zh: 這種方法的問題，例如 him、her、round 的句子，是它們，

cues.en: The sentences are fairly short and a little contrived, so they don't really have a large context window of relevancy.
cues.zh: 句子相當短，而且有點刻意，沒有很大的相關上下文視窗。

cues.en: And it's also difficult to scale up data sets like that.
cues.zh: 這類資料集也很難擴充。

cues.en: You know, it's one thing to come up with like 50 sentences, but it's just not feasible to have thousands
cues.zh: 想出大約 50 個句子是一回事，但要有幾千個手工

cues.en: of handcrafted sentences with a particular part of speech in a particular token position that are coded
cues.zh: 設計、由人編寫，或至少監督，讓特定 token 位置具有特定詞性的

cues.en: or at least supervised by a human anyway.
cues.zh: 句子，實在不可行。

cues.en: Obviously, the solution is to use some other routines or libraries that can categorize words into parts of speech.
cues.zh: 顯然，解法是使用其他程序或函式庫，將字詞分類為不同詞性。

cues.en: Now, one of those libraries that is fairly often used is called spacy.
cues.zh: 其中一個相當常用的函式庫，叫作 spaCy。

cues.en: It's a fairly big and versatile library.
cues.zh: 它相當龐大，用途靈活，

cues.en: It does a lot of stuff.
cues.zh: 能做很多事情。

cues.en: And in this video I will introduce you to just the basic usage of this library for identifying parts of speech in written text.
cues.zh: 這支影片，只會介紹如何用它辨識書寫文字詞性的基本用法。
